name: durable-learning-memory-readiness
repository_ready_when: durable conversation history is persisted and restored
only externally evidenced success can update reusable lessons
repeated success can create a skill candidate
candidate promotion requires explicit prior approval
learning failure cannot rewrite successful action truth
production_ready_when: revision is deployed to the Debian production host
the production CLI can write/read the durable memory database
real successful ACT evidence produces a durable learning record
subsequent interaction reuses a relevant durable lesson
current_claim: repository implementation only; production deployment and live learning evidence are not yet claimed
